entries.label: Kavriva KPSS Nedir
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Kavriva KPSS onboarding transparent illustration, canonical A Geometric Editorial. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES only, preserve their same frontal clean restrained digital geometry, indigo white pale-lavender and dark ink line language. Generate a new subject, never duplicate the references. One strong silhouette, 2–3 main motifs, generous negative space, square transparent canvas centered object occupies70%. Frontal or near-frontal flat + very restrained soft depth, shallow overlap short soft shadow, crisp smooth outlines, large simple shapes. Palette primary indigo #4F46E5 direction with white/cool neutral pale surfaces; approximate generated shading not final tokens. No isometric slabs, bevels, toy glossy plastic, volumetric lights, 3D emoji, gradients backgrounds, stock cartoon, humans, robot, mascot, logo, K, wordmark. No letters numbers labels button UI copy or watermarks anywhere. Rounded neutral line motifs allowed as symbolic detail, no actual interface screenshot.
Fourth input is ONBOARD-03 family hero STYLE reference only. Asset ID: ONBOARD-01. Subject: Introducing guided personalized preparation: one central pale open-ended structured learning tile with three large geometric modules (triangle, circle, quarter arc) held within one indigo guiding frame and a small outward direction cue. Calm personal progress and intelligent structure, no book, no graduation, no actual UI.
